                          [4-430] paragraph
                            [4-1454] StaticText: To mark her first day as president of Columbia University, Jennifer L. Mnookin reflected on the values that have been part of this institution’s story from the very beginning. From telescopes in service of the American Revolution to seismometers on the moon and satellites in orbit, Columbians have never stopped asking questions, searching for answers, and following the evidence wherever it leads.

                          [4-429] heading: A Spirit of Discovery
                          [4-430] paragraph
                            [4-1454] StaticText: To mark her first day as president of Columbia University, Jennifer L. Mnookin reflected on the values that have been part of this institution’s story from the very beginning. From telescopes in service of the American Revolution to seismometers on the moon and satellites in orbit, Columbians have never stopped asking questions, searching for answers, and following the evidence wherever it leads.
